meta.title: Add profiling-guided optimization to VM
meta.body_summary: Add profiling-guided optimization infrastructure to the VM: track instruction counts, collect execution profiles, and provide passes to remove cold instructions.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added PGO infrastructure; PR closed by author after ~48h with zero reviews or comments, no performance evidence provided.
